condition: Standard hit roll.

condition: Standard hit roll.

effect: Deal ordinary formula damage using the caster's attack.

effect: Deal ordinary formula damage using the caster's attack.
condition: Standard hit roll.

effect: Deal ordinary formula damage using the caster's attack.

name: whisker needle
effect: Deal ordinary formula damage using the caster's attack.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: fireball
effect: Deal ordinary formula damage using the caster's attack.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: fast claw
effect: Deal ordinary formula damage with priority +1.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: shooting star
effect: Deal ordinary formula damage with priority +1.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: double strike
effect: Deal ordinary damage on the first hit and independently roll a second hit. The caller applies the second hit to the opposing combatant's HP using the returned amount.
condition: First hit required. Second roll uses the initial hit threshold and requires the original opponent to be alive. Recalculate second damage for the surviving substitute or body.

name: magic arrow
effect: Deal ordinary damage on the first hit and independently roll a second hit. The caller applies the second hit to the opposing combatant's HP using the returned amount.
condition: First hit required. Second roll uses the initial hit threshold and requires the original opponent to be alive. Recalculate second damage for the surviving substitute or body.

name: bonemerang
effect: Deal ordinary damage on the first hit and independently roll a second hit. The caller applies the second hit to the opposing combatant's HP using the returned amount.
condition: First hit required. Second roll uses the initial hit threshold and requires the original opponent to be alive. Recalculate second damage for the surviving substitute or body.

name: pierce
effect: Deal ordinary damage and recoil for floor(actual damage / 2).
condition: Standard hit roll. Helmet blocks recoil.

name: flesh explosion
effect: Deal ordinary damage and recoil for floor(actual damage / 2).
condition: Standard hit roll. Helmet blocks recoil.

name: firebird
effect: Deal ordinary damage and recoil for floor(actual damage / 2).
condition: Standard hit roll. Helmet blocks recoil.

name: drain
effect: Deal ordinary damage and heal the caster for floor(actual damage / 2), capped at maximum HP.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: kiss
effect: Deal ordinary damage and heal the caster for floor(actual damage / 2), capped at maximum HP.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: counter
effect: Return a counter marker for the caller to apply last recorded damage plus half rounded down. Priority -1.
condition: Standard hit roll, nonzero last damage, and no protecting opponent substitute. Skipped if this is the first action.

name: elemental orb
effect: Deal fixed damage equal to power, capped at target HP.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: despair
effect: Remove floor(target current HP / 2).
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: power up
effect: Add floor(base attack / power) to caster attack.
condition: No hit roll.

name: defend
effect: Add floor(base defense / power) to caster defense.
condition: No hit roll.

name: earth castle
effect: Add floor(base defense / power) to caster defense.
condition: No hit roll.

name: acceleration
effect: Add floor(base speed / power) to caster speed.
condition: No hit roll.

name: meditation
effect: Set caster accuracy to min(80, current accuracy + power).
condition: No hit roll.

name: afterimage
effect: Set caster evasion to min(80, current evasion + power).
condition: No hit roll.

name: fog
effect: Set caster evasion to min(80, current evasion + power).
condition: No hit roll.

name: weakness
effect: Subtract floor(target base attack / power) from target attack, minimum 1.
condition: Standard hit roll against the opposing body only.

name: curse
effect: Subtract floor(target base defense / power) from target defense, minimum 1.
condition: Standard hit roll against the opposing body only.

name: sticky
effect: Subtract floor(target base speed / power) from target speed, minimum 1.
condition: Standard hit roll against the opposing body only.

name: spider web
effect: Subtract floor(target base speed / power) from target speed, minimum 1.
condition: Standard hit roll against the opposing body only.

name: distraction
effect: Subtract power from target accuracy, minimum -80.
condition: Standard hit roll against the opposing body only.

name: terror
effect: Subtract power from target evasion, minimum -80.
condition: Standard hit roll against the opposing body only.

name: tie up
effect: Subtract power from target evasion, minimum -80.
condition: Standard hit roll against the opposing body only.

name: fracture
effect: Reduce target attack and defense by their own base values divided by power with floor rounding, minimum 1 each.
condition: Standard hit roll against the opposing body only.

name: paralyze
effect: Apply stun to the opponent.
condition: Standard hit roll against the body. Blocked by existing stun or immunity.

name: plague
effect: Apply poison to the opponent.
condition: Standard hit roll against the body. Blocked by existing poison or immunity.

name: pumpkin seed
effect: Apply sprout to the opponent.
condition: Standard hit roll against the body. Blocked by existing sprout or immunity.

name: regenerate
effect: Apply regeneration to the caster.
condition: No hit roll. Blocked by existing regeneration or immunity.

name: aim
effect: Apply target to the opponent, making branches that check the mark set the hit threshold to 100.
condition: Standard hit roll against the body. Blocked by existing target or immunity.

name: sing
effect: Apply sleep to the opponent.
condition: Standard hit roll against the body. Blocked by existing sleep or immunity.

name: typereverse
effect: Attempt to apply reverse independently to caster and opponent.
condition: Standard hit roll against the body first. Each recipient's reverse or immunity blocks that recipient.

name: veilguard
effect: Apply aurora to the caster, multiplying the ordinary damage divisor by 1.5.
condition: No hit roll. Blocked by existing aurora or immunity.

name: immune
effect: Apply immunity to the caster. Individual effect branches check this status.
condition: No hit roll. Blocked by existing immunity.

name: dinolize
effect: Raise caster attack and defense by floor(the respective base stat / power).
condition: No hit roll.

name: bullseye
effect: Raise caster attack by floor(base attack / power) and accuracy by 10, capped at 80.
condition: No hit roll.

name: battojutsu
effect: Raise caster attack and speed by floor(the respective base stat / power).
condition: No hit roll.

name: release
effect: Raise attack and defense by floor(base attack / power) and speed by floor(base speed / power).
condition: Roll 1–100 at or below skill accuracy plus caster accuracy. No target evasion term.

name: magician hat
effect: Shuffle attack, defense, and speed. Raise the first by floor(3 × corresponding base / 4), lower the second by floor(base / 4) to a minimum of 1.
condition: No hit roll. The raised and lowered stats are distinct.

name: heart of lion
effect: Spend base HP and increase attack by base attack.
condition: Caster HP must exceed base HP.

name: rigid
effect: Increase caster damage reduction by 5.
condition: No hit roll.

name: molt
effect: Restore full HP and reduce defense by floor(base defense / power), minimum 1.
condition: No hit roll.

name: sap screw
effect: Lower target attack by floor(target base attack / power), minimum 1. Heal caster by the actual decrease up to maximum HP.
condition: Standard hit roll. The target can be a substitute.

name: recoilless
effect: Apply helmet to the caster to block recoil.
condition: No hit roll. Blocked by existing helmet or immunity.

name: sturdy kick
effect: Deal ordinary damage and raise caster defense by floor(base defense / 4).
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: deathscythe
effect: Set target current HP to exactly 1.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: blood leech
effect: Deal ordinary damage and heal the caster for the full actual damage, limited by maximum HP.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: will of wisp
effect: Deal ordinary damage and reduce the target's accuracy by 10, minimum -80.
condition: Standard hit roll. A substitute receives the damage without the accuracy reduction.

name: discharge
effect: Deal ordinary damage and subtract floor(base attack / 4) from caster attack without a minimum.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: flame wheel
effect: Deal fixed damage up to target HP and recoil for floor(actual damage / 2).
condition: Standard hit roll. Helmet blocks recoil.

name: rage
effect: Deal ordinary damage on a hit. On a miss, caster loses floor(uncapped formula damage / 2) unless wearing helmet.
condition: Standard hit roll. Helmet prevents the miss recoil.

name: trick or treat
effect: Change caster's current type uniformly to a different Beast, Elemental, or Undead type. Normal can become any of the three.
condition: No hit roll.

name: blessed horn
effect: Deal ordinary damage and raise caster attack by floor(base attack / 4).
condition: Standard hit roll. Registry accuracy is 100.

name: blindfist
effect: Deal ordinary damage and reduce caster accuracy by 10 to a minimum of -80.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: mimic
effect: The caller runs the opponent's recorded action through the normal action wrapper. Priority -1.
condition: No separate hit roll. Opponent action cannot be mimic or counter. A leading priority -1 action is skipped.

name: jiujitsu
effect: Deal formula damage using target attack as the numerator stat.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: flash beak
effect: Deal formula damage using caster speed as the numerator stat. Priority +1.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: shield slam
effect: Deal formula damage using caster defense as the numerator stat.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: judgement
effect: Deal ordinary damage with the favorable type multiplier against Undead as well as Elemental. Reverse flips the result.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: gold rush
effect: Deal ordinary damage and award the player 100 times the floor in gold through either action wrapper.
condition: Standard hit roll.

name: acid stone
effect: Deal positive fixed power minus target damage reduction when positive, limited by target HP. Then lower target damage reduction by 5, minimum 0.
condition: Standard hit roll. Damage reduction still falls when there is no HP damage.

name: hybrid attack
effect: Deal up to two fixed hits at power, with priority +1. The caller applies the returned second damage to the opposing body.
condition: First hit required for a second roll. Both rolls reuse the initial hit threshold. If the substitute falls, recalculate against the body.

name: icebolt
effect: Deal ordinary damage with a possible stun flag. The action wrapper applies stun.
condition: Standard hit roll. Roll 1–100 at or below 30 for an opposing body without stun or immunity. The target must survive to receive the status.

name: poison tail
effect: Deal ordinary damage with a possible poison flag. The action wrapper applies poison.
condition: Standard hit roll. Roll 1–100 at or below 30 for an opposing body without poison or immunity. The target must survive to receive the status.

name: stinger
effect: Deal fixed damage and uniformly choose stun or poison for the action wrapper to apply.
condition: Standard hit roll. A surviving opposing body must lack stun, poison, and immunity.

name: heal
effect: Heal caster for floor(maximum HP / power), limited by missing HP.
condition: No hit roll.

name: recovery
effect: Call the status-removal routine with its immediate-cure flag.
condition: No hit roll. Stun and sleep allow the caster to attempt recovery. List-mutation caveat applies.

name: imitation
effect: Copy the opponent's skills, attack, defense, accuracy, evasion, damage reduction, and type, and apply imitation. Copies include the base and current values of the listed stats.
condition: No hit roll or immunity check. The player reads the opponent's base registry by name and receives five uses per copied skill.

name: revive
effect: Spend 20 HP to create a substitute with 20 HP.
condition: Caster HP must exceed 20 and caster's substitute must be absent or depleted.

name: breath
effect: Deal ordinary formula damage only at or below half caster maximum HP.
condition: Standard hit roll is consumed even when caster HP is too high.

name: sacrifice
effect: Deal floor(caster base HP / 2), limited by target HP. Recoil is half actual damage rounded down unless helmet is active.
condition: No hit roll. Offered to the player only when every unlocked slot has zero uses. No memorized use is consumed.
